How does the Panic Code work?

The Panic Code is an extreme emergency measure. WHAT IT DOES: Irreversibly wipes all local data (database, files, encryption keys) and logs out the account immediately. HOW TO TRIGGER IT: 1. On the LOGIN screen: Enter it instead of your password. 2. On the HOME screen: Tap the search icon, type the code, and press enter.

The original offline model. Extremely lightweight, fast, and low battery usage. Perfect for short commands or low-end devices, though it does not support advanced punctuation.
The entry-level AI model. Offers great fluency and significantly better speech comprehension than Vosk, with automatic punctuation and balanced context correction.
The recommended choice for most modern devices. Thanks to 5-bit neural quantization, it retains 98% of native Small model accuracy while reducing size and speeding up offline execution.
High-fidelity neural model with minimal 8-bit quantization. Delivers excellent transcription detail, nearly indistinguishable from the uncompressed model, requiring capable processors.
The full uncompressed (Float16) neural model. Achieves maximum theoretical accuracy but requires over 480 MB of storage and considerable processing time on standard devices.
OpenAI distilled model with the extraordinary accuracy of Large-v3, optimized to run at Whisper Small speed.
Advanced feature for developers or benchmarking. Runs Vosk and Whisper Base simultaneously, comparing and displaying both text streams.

How to unlock Restricted Settings on Android 13/14/15+:

1. Temporarily leave the app and go to your home screen or app drawer.
2. Long-press the CryptionChat icon and select \"App info\" (or go to Settings -> Apps -> CryptionChat).
3. At the top right, tap the three vertical dots (⋮).
4. Select \"Allow restricted settings\".
5. Confirm using your device fingerprint or PIN.
6. Reopen CryptionChat and try enabling the overlay permission again.

Note: This is an Android system security restriction applied to all apps installed outside Google Play Store.

If you receive a message that starts with your exact passphrase, the app will trigger.

Advanced Commands List:
• (no command): Instantly wipes all data, chats, and the local app database.

• /off: Forcefully powers off the phone (Requires Shizuku).

• /reboot: Reboots the phone (Requires Shizuku).

What is Shizuku used for in CryptionChat?
It allows the app to execute advanced Remote Kill Switch commands (e.g. /reboot, /off or /uninstall) directly at the system level, without full Root permissions.

METHOD 1: Via PC (All Android versions - ADB)
Requires a Windows/Mac/Linux computer.
1. Go to Settings > About phone and tap "Build number" 7 times.
2. Go to Developer options and enable USB debugging.
3. Connect your phone to the PC with a cable and allow debugging.
4. On your PC, install "Platform Tools" (ADB) and open a terminal.
5. Start the service by pasting this command:

(If you reboot your phone, you will need to repeat step 5).

METHOD 2: Without PC (Android 11+ only - Wireless Debugging)
1. In Developer options, enable Wireless debugging.
2. Open Shizuku and tap Pairing.
3. Tap "Developer options" from the prompt, open "Wireless debugging" and tap Pair device with pairing code.
4. Enter the 6-digit code in the notification shown by Shizuku.
5. Return to Shizuku and tap Start.

Final Step (For both methods):
Open Shizuku, go to Authorized applications and turn on the toggle for CryptionChat.
